# UiDrawer

A modal panel docked to an edge of the viewport.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | overlays |
| Import | `import { UiDrawer } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiDrawer from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiDrawer'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/overlays/UiDrawer.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/overlays/UiDrawer.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` **(required)** | `string` |  | Accessible name and visible heading. |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `side` | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'` | `'end'` | Edge the panel is attached to. `start`/`end` follow the writing direction. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'full'` | `'md'` | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `hideTitle` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `closable` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `closeOnBackdrop` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `initialFocus` | `(() => HTMLElement \| null \| undefined)` |  |  |
| `returnFocus` | `(() => HTMLElement \| null \| undefined)` |  |  |

## Attributes

The native `<dialog>` (through UiDialog).

## Keyboard

- Same as UiDialog: contained Tab order, Escape, focus restoration.

## Accessibility

- A modal dialog with the same semantics as UiDialog.
- `start`/`end` follow the writing direction; the short entry slide is removed with reduced motion.

## Styling

- `.vui-dialog.vui-drawer`
- `data-side`, `data-size`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <UiButton variant="outline" color="neutral" data-testid="drawer-open" @click="openDrawer('end')">{{
    t('demo.drawer.open')
  }}</UiButton>
  <UiButton variant="ghost" color="neutral" @click="openDrawer('start')">start</UiButton>
  <UiButton variant="ghost" color="neutral" @click="openDrawer('bottom')">bottom</UiButton>
</div>
<UiDrawer
  v-model:open="drawerOpen"
  :side="drawerSide"
  :title="t('demo.drawer.title')"
  :description="t('demo.dialog.description')"
>
  <div class="grid gap-3">
    <UiSwitch v-model="notify" :label="t('demo.notifications')" label-placement="start" />
    <UiInput v-model="workspace" :label="t('settings.name')" />
  </div>
  <template #footer="{ close }">
    <UiButton @click="close">{{ t('actions.done') }}</UiButton>
  </template>
</UiDrawer>
```
